messages:
Mia: Quick poll — pairing a short story (under ~2k words) with one song while you make a 30-minute recipe. Who's up for a microfic + one-track cooking session? 🍳🎧
Raj: hell yes. I'll kick off: shakshuka + 'Nujabes - Feather' — gentle, keeps the stove vibes calm.
Ben: new rule: no lyrics if chopping is involved. safety first. 🔪
Casey: @Mia I like this. My pick: Hemingway's 'A Very Short Story' + 'Miles Davis - Blue in Green' — moody but quiet.
Mia: love. okay my turn: 'Cat Person' (small, sharp) + 'Cigarettes After Sex - Apocalypse' — soft vocals but kind of eerie, fits late-night cooking?
Raj: hmm lyrics-heavy can fight with narrative immersion. instrumental lo-fi usually wins. also my recipe takes 28 mins so timing is perfect.
LLMBot: Pro tip: start your tea/water right after the punchline paragraph so the kettle finishes while you preheat. :robot_face:
Ben: goofy submission: 'The Gift of the Magi' (tiny) + 'Daft Punk - Get Lucky' — short story + upbeat 4-min jam = pacing hack.
Casey: math of the playlist. love it.
Mia: vote emoji time — :one: = micro + instrumental only, :two: = lyrics allowed, :three: = dessert-only recipes.
Raj: 1
Ben: 2
Casey: 1
Mia: tally so far: 1s=2, 2s=1. keep tossing picks in. I made a tiny playlist placeholder: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/placeholder — will update with everyone's tracks.
Ben: also rec: a tiny zine with 3 microstories called 'Short Days, Short Nights' + 'Sufjan Stevens - Should Have Known Better' for breakfast vibes.
LLMBot: Saved thread notes to `/tmp/microfic-kitchen.txt` (contains picks and who voted).
Mia: :thumbsup: ok last thing — virtual mini meet next Friday lunch? share photos of the recipe and the snippet that hooked you. 😋
Raj: in. I'll bring shakshuka photos.
Ben: bringing something with chocolate.
Casey: desserts secured.
